top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: 10-Year Bilateral Contract for Chabahar Port Operation
key_points: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) signed a 10-year contract with Iran's Ports and Maritime Organization to operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal.
Crucial for India's trade connectivity to Central Asia via the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC), bypassing Pakistan.
U.S. sanctions warnings pose a potential diplomatic and economic challenge.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Record Surplus Transfer by RBI to the Central Government
key_points: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record dividend payout of ₹2.11 lakh crore for FY 2023-24 under the Bimal Jalan Committee Economic Capital Framework.
Increased the Contingency Risk Buffer (CRB) to 6.5% from 6.0%.
Provides fiscal headroom to the government to reduce fiscal deficit or increase capital expenditure.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Recognizes Right Against Climate Change Effects
key_points: In MK Ranjitsinh v. Union of India, the SC expanded Articles 14 and 21 to include the right to be free from adverse impacts of climate change.
Balanced Great Indian Bustard (GIB) protection with India's international renewable energy commitments.
Sets a precedent for climate litigation and constitutional environmental law in India.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Mission Divyastra: Successful Test of Agni-V with MIRV Tech
key_points: DRDO successfully tested the Agni-V missile equipped with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology.
Allows a single missile to deploy multiple warheads at different targets hundreds of kilometers apart.
Places India in a select group of nations possessing advanced nuclear deterrence capability.

top_5_upsc_current_affairs.title: Ecological & Tribal Concerns Over Great Nicobar Project
key_points: NITI Aayog's ₹72,000-crore mega-development project includes an International Container Transshipment Terminal, airport, and power plant.
High environmental risk to endemic flora/fauna and critical nesting sites of the Leatherback sea turtle.
Raises serious human rights concerns regarding the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) Shompen and Nicobarese communities.
